description: This file defines a Java class 'ErrorResult' which implements the 'Result' interface, representing an error outcome in a system involving commands and events. It encapsulates an exception and a command that caused the error, providing methods for string representation and visitor pattern acceptance.

classes.name: ErrorResult
classes.description: A final class representing an error result, parameterized with an event type E, implementing the Result interface.

methods.name: ErrorResult
methods.description: Constructor initializing the error with a RuntimeException and the command that caused it.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ErrorResult, including exception and command details.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a ResultVisitor and invokes its onError method with the stored exception and command.
